title: Löckelle Teardown Services Sledge
description: This resourcepack adds the Sledge from Teardown (replaces the iron pickaxe)
body:
This resource pack adds the _**Sledge**_ from Teardown, as it reads...

I remade this using screenshot reference photos and Blockbench, because why not? I love Teardown, credit goes to **Tuxedo Labs**

it's a really fun game, pls play it!
(you wont hate it)
